svg.text: EAS 18425:2026 & FprEN 18352 CAPABILITY PROGRESSION (ML1–ML2 TO CL3–CL4)
Alignment of ODGS work products (Clauses 5–8) with Capability Level 3 (Established) and Capability Level 4 (Predictable — PA 4.1/4.2)
COVERED IN EAS 18425:2026 EDITION 1 (ML1 & ML2)
Capability Level 1 (CL1) · Performed Process (PA 1.1)
• Process achieves its purpose and produces identifiable outputs
• Typical Artefacts: Ad-hoc policy documents, initial inventories,
basic data catalogues, manual checklists
Mode: Manual / Informal
Capability Level 2 (CL2) · Managed Process (PA 2.1, PA 2.2)
• Process is planned, monitored, and adjusted; work products
are appropriately established, controlled, and maintained
• Typical Artefacts: Risk registers, written Data Usage Agreements,
glossary definitions, periodic audit reports
Mode: Documentary & Retrospective Attestation
SUPPLIED BY THIS CONTRIBUTION (CAPABILITY LEVELS 3 & 4)
Capability Level 3 (CL3) · Established Process (PA 3.1, PA 3.2)
• Standard process defined and deployed consistently across operational contexts
• Work Product 1 (Clause 6 & Annex D): Machine-readable constraint schema bound via
semantic_hash (SHA-256) to statute/rulebook & bound to process_urn
Applies to EAS 18425 Clauses 5.4, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4 & 7
Capability Level 4 (CL4) · Predictable Process (PA 4.1 Measurement, PA 4.2 Control)
EAS 18425 Table 1: "The process operates within defined limits and is controlled using quantitative
data. Required evidence: Measurement results, defined thresholds, and evidence of data-driven control."
• Enforcement Gate (Clause 7): Deterministic HARD_STOP / SOFT_STOP when limits are breached
• Work Product 2 (Clause 8 & Annex A): Signed S-Cert receipt substantiating FprEN 18352 §11.2.4
Mode: Deterministic Runtime Control & Cryptographic Evidence
